Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

The two new Passes rows match the UI labels and defaults. The description matches the kept-piece and back-stock rules. The decision file records the scope and the reason. This change meets #3680.

Local results:

- Reviewed the complete diff against current upstream main, `267ee5096bde18de7c82f18bc93c041a773baa97`.
- The PR directly contains that main commit. The trial merge reported `Already up to date.` No merge commit was needed. HEAD is the PR head; HEAD^1 is main.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; zero steps selected for this documentation change.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed; six steps, zero failures. The release build passed. The motion lib passed seven tests. Each of `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start` passed one test. Total: 11 tests passed.
- Focused documentation check: the two rows are absent on main and present with the correct defaults on this head.

Extra suites run:

`PYTHONPATH=site/tests python3 -m unittest -v test_guide_icons test_operation_reference`

Eight test methods passed. Two test methods failed, with four assertion failures. I ran the same command on bare upstream main. It gave the same results and failures:

- `test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app`: two missing icons and the resulting set mismatch.
- `test_every_operation_has_section_and_picture`: missing `RotaryFlow` coverage.

The failure text includes:

```text
Missing site icon .../site/static/icons/op-rotary-flow.png
Missing site icon .../site/static/icons/tool-form-mill.png
'op-rotary-flow', 'tool-form-mill' : Stale or missing PNGs in site/static/icons/
'RotaryFlow' : Update the reference when OpType changes
```

These failures exist on bare main. They do not block this PR. I found no issue that specifically tracks these site test failures.

The Zola render tests passed, including the site prefix checks. The guide component check passed.

Safety and scope:

- This PR changes documentation only. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation.
- Safety mutations do not apply. No goldens moved. No UI source changed, so before/after UI screenshots do not apply.
- No importer or fixture suite was required. No application clippy step was selected. No heavy lane or GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

The review worktree and its build files remain on this host for the next round. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

merge-ready: clean review of this docs-only PR at head 5d112cc (trial merge clean, no code change; see the review comment). No other review-state labels are present. Note: `gh pr edit --add-label` failed on a GraphQL Projects deprecation warning in this environment, so the label set was verified via the REST API - it is already in the correct state and needed no change.
